paper_id: Guo et al. - 2020 - Aloba rethinking ON-OFF keying modulation for ambient LoRa backscatter
title: Aloba: Rethinking ON-OFF Keying Modulation for Ambient LoRa Backscatter
motivation: 工业物联网需要低功耗长距回传，但现有方案牺牲吞吐量换距离或反之
problem_framing: 同频带叠加的LoRa载波与回传信号如何同时解调
key_insight: 把LoRa线性调频转为正弦音可将相/幅变化作为回传数据线索
method_signature: LoRa包检测+调频转正弦+两步相位对齐+聚类解码
evaluation_criteria: 吞吐量39.5-199.4 Kbps，距离50-200 m，较PLoRa优10.4-52.4倍
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 增益主要在短中距(≤250 m)，长距需牺牲速率；回传距离受限于信号衰减和能量损耗
evidence_for_taste: None of them is able to balance the throughput and communication range
The performance gain of Aloba over PloRa is achieved mainly within short and medium communication range (≤250 m)
the backscatter signal is orders of magnitude weaker than the carrier signal
we cannot blindly borrow the idea of LoRa parallel decoding
thinking_moves: 发现现有方案的二元对立困境后重新审视经典调制方案
将解调问题重构为信号变换后的相位幅值检测
用两步相位对齐消除调频边界假报警
用聚类代替瞬时跳变检测以抗相位噪声
承认方案在长距场景的固有局限并指出改进方向
